text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин is defeated by Biwa
Hayahide's
overwhelming abilities in the
Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Both her loss and the difficulties she
faced in
training weigh heavily on her,
and she breaks
from mental and physical
exhaustion.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She confesses that she needs a break
from both
training and racing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
